messages.subject: Renjin on Android
parts:
Hi there,
sorry for not replying earlier, but I didn't see your comment on the wiki-- i think questions are probably better addressed to the google groups (renji...@googlegroups.com) 

I have zero experience with Android development, so I can't give you a definitive answer, but from what I understand, the major limitation of the Dvalik VM is that you cannot generate bytecode on the fly, which Renjin does as an optimization strategy for large data. This means that you might run into errors at runtime, but it would be straightforward make Renjin configurable so that you could turn JIT compilation off.

There are bound to be other more minor errors, either because of security or missing java apis, but these should be able to work around. 

And obviously, if you want an R repl on android, you would need to write a user interface.

Again, I know nothing about Android development, but my sense is that you would be better off running renjin on a server (AppEngine for example) and allow an Android client to connect to that server through an API.

HTH,
Alex
